long_description: FundOS is the agentic operating system for fund managers. It replaces the manual "human glue" between a fund's systems with audit-logged AI agents — covenant monitoring, capital calls, diligence, recon, and reporting — running on the data funds already have, via MCP, with no migration. Dogfooded at Eight Capital, where FundOS runs a 270+ company YC portfolio off a single spine of data, auto-generating NAVs and K-1s. Clients include Semper Capital (London) and a New York asset manager. SOC 2, role-based access, LP-scoped data, and a full audit trail. Built by a team that ran a credit fund for 15 years.
name: VantedgeAI
one_liner: FundOS — AI operations for fund managers
